text.en: PaLM is row 39 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: PaLM 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 39 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates PaLM with “PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways”.
text.zh: 年度表把 PaLM 与论文《PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Aakanksha Chowdhery, Sharan Narang, Jacob Devlin, Kathy Meier-Hellstern, Douglas Eck, Jeff Dean, Slav Petrov, Noah Fiedel”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 阿坎莎·乔杜里、沙兰·纳朗、雅各布·德夫林、凯西·迈尔-赫尔斯特恩、道格拉斯·埃克、杰夫·迪恩、斯拉夫·彼得罗夫、诺亚·菲德尔；官方英文原文为“Aakanksha Chowdhery, Sharan Narang, Jacob Devlin, Kathy Meier-Hellstern, Douglas Eck, Jeff Dean, Slav Petrov, Noah Fiedel”。

text.en: PaLM uses pathways-distributed dense transformer scaling.
text.zh: PaLM 采用基于 Pathways 的稠密 Transformer 分布式扩展。

text.en: Experts generally treat PaLM as a landmark in the co-design of large models and accelerator infrastructure. It also supplied influential evidence that some language-model capabilities can improve sharply rather than smoothly with scale.
text.zh: 专家通常把 PaLM 视为大模型与加速器基础设施协同设计的里程碑。它还提供了有影响力的证据，说明某些语言模型能力可能随规模出现跃升，而不是平滑增长。
